title: Ashen Delta: The Machinist's Tide Ledger
premise: In a marsh where glass reeds record vanished flood levels, the machinist must rebalance a failing mechanical relay using a portable phase regulator.
ending: Recover the Tide Ledger and return with the stable field relay; Delta Ferrymen can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive silt lightning while evading the drowned warden without sacrificing the stable field relay.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Delta Ferrymen to witness the portable phase regulator.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to divert power from a shelter
